metadata.title: Scientific campaign method template reference instance

belongs_in_method_template: minimum structured obligations for each methodological stage
clear ownership boundaries against campaign execution records, evidence packs, continuation packets, and budget policy
outside_method_template: research evidence pack payloads and claim provenance bodies
continuation packet payloads for future work handoff

phases.label: Question framing
phases.purpose: Define the target question, scope, and decision boundary before downstream work starts.
completion_signals: question wording is specific enough to falsify or complete
non-goals are explicit instead of implied

input_linkages.purpose: The question-framing stage starts from the canonical campaign phase record rather than a copied execution snapshot.

output_linkages.purpose: Framing completion is handed back through the campaign phase record so lifecycle state stays upstream.

phases.label: Prior knowledge consolidation
phases.purpose: Summarize relevant prior knowledge and open contradictions before hypotheses or designs are promoted.
completion_signals: prior art is linked rather than paraphrased into folklore
knowledge gaps are preserved for later design decisions

input_linkages.purpose: The phase reads campaign lifecycle context from the canonical campaign phase record.
Prior knowledge consolidation must cite durable evidence packs instead of retelling them from memory.

output_linkages.purpose: The consolidated result returns to the campaign phase record as the lifecycle-owned handoff anchor.
The phase outputs evidence-pack references rather than embedding source-provenance payloads.

phases.label: Hypothesis registry
phases.purpose: Record the candidate hypotheses, assumptions, and comparison conditions that the campaign will test.
required_outputs: claim-strength tiers, falsifiability notes, and uncertainty state for each hypothesis
completion_signals: assumptions are explicit enough to challenge later

input_linkages.purpose: Hypothesis registration inherits campaign lifecycle status from the phase record.
Hypothesis strength is grounded in linked evidence packs rather than copied source payloads.

output_linkages.purpose: Registered hypotheses are exposed back through the phase record without moving ownership of lifecycle truth.

hypotheses.statement: A humidity-linked process drift may explain the batch instability, but current evidence is still thin.
hypotheses.falsifiability_notes: If matched humidity and process-control runs erase the instability difference, discard this hunch.
support_basis: operator observation from two anomalous batches
hypotheses.uncertainty_notes: Confounded by instrumentation drift and sparse repeats.
unresolved_questions: Was sensor recalibration performed before both anomalous runs?

hypotheses.statement: Surface treatment B improves adhesion retention versus baseline A under the same cure cycle.
hypotheses.falsifiability_notes: If blinded matched runs do not reproduce a retention gap larger than measurement noise, demote the claim.
support_basis: three prior matched pilot runs showed higher retention
two independent operators reproduced the preparation sequence
hypotheses.uncertainty_notes: Small sample count and cure-temperature variance still limit certainty.
unresolved_questions: Does the effect persist after extended humidity aging?

phases.label: Experiment design
phases.purpose: Describe how the work will generate evidence without fixing domain-specific experimental policy in the template itself.
completion_signals: design can be inspected for confounds
measurement expectations are concrete enough for later analysis

input_linkages.purpose: Experiment design reads the current campaign phase state from the canonical phase record.
Design decisions must trace back to evidence-pack references produced during prior knowledge consolidation.

output_linkages.purpose: Design approval flows through the campaign phase record rather than a duplicate method-template status field.

phases.label: Analysis plan
phases.purpose: Define how evidence will be interpreted, compared, or rejected before outcome narratives are written.
completion_signals: success, failure, and ambiguity cases are distinguished in advance
analysis criteria do not depend on hidden prompt memory

input_linkages.purpose: Analysis planning inherits campaign execution context from the phase record.
Analysis criteria reference the same durable evidence-pack chain used during design.

output_linkages.purpose: The analysis plan is handed off through the campaign phase record for downstream execution tracking.

phases.label: Adversarial review
phases.purpose: Stress the current plan for blind spots, missing controls, or overclaim risk before the final outcome story hardens.
required_inputs: known weak assumptions or contested evidence
completion_signals: repair requirements are captured instead of silently waived

input_linkages.purpose: Adversarial review reads the same campaign phase truth that will own any repair or block decision.
Challenge questions stay tied to explicit evidence-pack references.

output_linkages.purpose: Review verdicts and repair obligations are handed back through the campaign phase record.

review.prompt: Try to falsify the stronger adhesion claim before outcome writeup. Look for confounds, hidden operator choices, and weak comparison conditions.
challenge_questions: Could cure-temperature variance explain the apparent treatment advantage?
What blind or randomized control is still missing before promotion beyond a working campaign claim?
review.residual_risk_notes: Proceed only if the next run set locks cure temperature and keeps operator sequencing blinded.

phases.label: Outcome documentation
phases.purpose: Record what was learned, what failed, and what remains uncertain after the work is executed.
required_outputs: explicit statement of what was not proved
completion_signals: the outcome summary distinguishes evidence from interpretation

input_linkages.purpose: Outcome documentation reads the canonical phase lifecycle state from the campaign record.
Outcome narratives point back to evidence-pack refs instead of copying pack payloads inline.

output_linkages.purpose: Terminal success, failure, or uncertainty state is written back through the campaign phase record.
The phase emits evidence-pack refs for the supporting or conflicting outcome evidence.

outcome_record.summary: The planned follow-up run did not reproduce the expected adhesion-retention improvement for treatment B.
outcome_record.uncertainty_notes: The negative result weakens the stronger claim but does not yet isolate whether treatment chemistry or uncontrolled curing variance dominated.
unresolved_questions: Was the batch material itself outside normal tolerance?
failure_notes: The promoted stronger claim was not sustained under the follow-up run.
Instrumentation logging dropped one humidity channel during the failed attempt.

phases.label: Continuation
phases.purpose: Prepare the next-step handoff without embedding the continuation packet payload itself.
required_inputs: open questions and blocked follow-up items
completion_signals: future work has a clear next decision or stop condition
continuation obligations are explicit even when the campaign stops

input_linkages.purpose: Continuation planning starts from the canonical campaign phase record instead of a copied execution footer.
Continuation decisions carry forward the outcome evidence by reference.

output_linkages.purpose: The continuation decision updates campaign lifecycle truth through the phase record.
Successor work receives a continuation packet link instead of an inline payload copy.

continuation_notes.next_decision: Run one blinded repeat with locked cure temperature before promoting or discarding the treatment claim.
continuation_notes.handoff_summary: Carry forward the negative-result notes, residual adversarial-review risk, and the unresolved humidity-channel gap.
stop_conditions: Stop if the blinded repeat still fails to separate treatment effect from process noise.
Stop if the missing humidity channel cannot be recovered or replaced.
